official_description:
The Roland VAD516 elevates your drumming experience by blending the presence and feel of acoustic drums with the benefits of electronic versatility. Featuring full-size wood shells, double-braced chrome stands, and advanced digital triggering, the VAD516 delivers an immersive playing experience perfect for practice, recording, and performance.

Roland’s innovative digital technology ensures realistic sound and response, with customizable drum sounds and effects at your fingertips. The powerful TD-27 sound module provides a vast library of drum kits and the ability to create your custom sounds. Bluetooth connectivity adds more options, allowing you to play along with your favorite songs.
